title: Functions [Test Harnesses]
description:
## Test Harnesses
_This site has a problem_. It is _really_ easy to cheat, even in function lessons - you can just replace main with what it should do. Anybody would do that when they are having trouble instead of just . . . _thinking_. However, I now have a solution. This is called _test harnesses_. From now on, tests will be appended onto your code after you press run / submit, and will test your code without it being possible to cheat. Run will do fewer tests but not affect your lessons-in-a-row streak, and you won't pass the lesson. Submit does more tests and passes the lesson - but also will affect your streak. Your code will be in the Solution class, and the test harness will be appended later.
---
## Assignment
Write the function `bool isNegative(int num);`. It should return true if the number is negative, and false if not.
